headline: CHC @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.57 at NYM 4.54, with a projected total of 9.11. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: CHC moved +0.32 runs while NYM moved +0.12, changing the projected margin by +0.19 runs. The projected total climbed +0.44, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Sean Manaea has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Juan Soto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Brett Baty because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
